answer: A hostile operator running 44 aliases therefore needs 106 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in wander, expire in island, and canyon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 5 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
